authorization: User requested all feasible parts of the proposed steps 1-4; q100 and false alarms reported together
outer_split: existing 1620 train / 540 unused chunks within the same 36 WAVs; seed 42
candidate_oof: Replay the saved shuffled 3 chunk folds, preserving original sample order
target_transform: MinMaxScaler fitted on each fit split; targets in kW/m2
svr_input_scaler: StandardScaler fitted on each fit split

representations.band10: The same 10 features as the earlier pilots, including absolute log power
representations.frequency34: band10 + 24 relative log powers in uniform 125-Hz bands over 0-3000 Hz
representations.temporal46: band10 + six within-chunk distribution features in each of six 500-Hz bands: log power quantiles 0.1/0.5/0.9, CV, peak/mean, fraction above twice the mean

training_stress_condition: minus20, descriptive only; not used for candidate selection
integration_shortlist: Training clean OOF winners for RMSE, q100-first, FP-first, and last-stage common-negative correction; deduplicate identical prediction vectors
integration_catalog: training q100-first and FP-first finite weight-grid fits
affine Ridge with intercept if last-stage corrections exist

onb_weight_grid.selection: Separate q100-first and FP-first illustrations fitted to training clean OOF; no numeric FP limit assumed

diversity_penalty: lambda=0.25 * baseline OOF MSE; penalize positive pairwise residual correlation, alongside prediction MSE; descriptive training fit, not independent ensemble OOF validation
ensemble_oof_limitation: Existing saved base OOF predictions do not permit unbiased nested meta-model validation. Ensemble weights/meta-model use clean training OOF as fit/selection data, then are frozen before outer evaluation
outer_evaluation: All predefined candidates and frozen integration methods on the same 540 chunks, all seven noises; no method, hyperparameter, or weight selected from outer labels
development_limitation: This holdout has been inspected in earlier research; the comparison is developmental, not pristine confirmation
main_configuration: Keep the research runner and three production models unchanged until adoption is justified; matched remains a separate historical comparison
